description: This header file defines the interface for internal system event messaging, including functions for message creation, sending, receiving, and printing within a sysevent system. It also declares data structures and utility functions used by the system event library.

methods.name: SE_print_message
methods.description: Prints the content of a message of a given type.

methods.name: SE_string2size
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes required to store a string in a system event message.

methods.name: SE_print_message_hdr
methods.description: Prints a message header for debugging or logging.

methods.name: SE_msg_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string to a message buffer, including size indication and alignment.

methods.name: SE_msg_hdr_mbytes_fixup
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of the message payload in the message header.

methods.name: SE_msg_receive
methods.description: Blocks until a message is received on a file descriptor.

methods.name: SE_minimal_blocking_msg_receive
methods.description: Attempts to receive a message with a short wait, returning immediately if none is available.

methods.name: SE_msg_send
methods.description: Sends a message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: SE_msg_send_receive
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a reply.

methods.name: SE_msg_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a new system event message in a buffer.

methods.name: SE_msg_get_data
methods.description: Retrieves the data payload from a message.

methods.name: SE_msg_send_data
methods.description: Sends raw data over a file descriptor.

methods.name: SE_msg_add_data
methods.description: Adds raw data to a message buffer.
